description: This file defines classes and functions for pattern matching in PyTorch profiler events, including various pattern classes for detecting specific performance or coding patterns, and a reporting utility for anti-patterns.

classes.name: Pattern
classes.description: Base class for defining profiler event patterns, providing traversal, matching, and reporting utilities.

classes.name: NamePattern
classes.description: Pattern matching events by name using regex.

classes.name: ExtraCUDACopyPattern
classes.description: Detects pattern of creating CPU tensor and copying to GPU.

classes.name: ForLoopIndexingPattern
classes.description: Detects for-loop based tensor indexing that can be vectorized.

classes.name: FP32MatMulPattern
classes.description: Detects usage of GPU with TF32 support and suggests enabling TF32.

classes.name: OptimizerSingleTensorPattern
classes.description: Detects usage of single-tensor optimizer implementations.

classes.name: SynchronizedDataLoaderPattern
classes.description: Detects DataLoader with num_workers=0 indicating synchronous loading.

classes.name: GradNotSetToNonePattern
classes.description: Detects zero_grad calls that do not set grad to None.

classes.name: Conv2dBiasFollowedByBatchNorm2dPattern
classes.description: Detects Conv2d with bias enabled followed by BatchNorm2d.

classes.name: MatMulDimInFP16Pattern
classes.description: Detects matrix multiplication with unaligned dimensions in FP16.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if an event matches the pattern.

methods.name: matched_events
methods.description: Returns all events matching the pattern.

methods.name: root_of
methods.description: Finds the root ancestor of an event.

methods.name: siblings_of
methods.description: Returns sibling events of a given event.

methods.name: go_up_until
methods.description: Traverses up the event tree until a predicate is satisfied.

methods.name: source_code_location
methods.description: Retrieves source code location from an event.

methods.name: input_shapes
methods.description: Extracts input tensor shapes from an event.

methods.name: input_dtypes
methods.description: Extracts input tensor data types from an event.

methods.name: report_all_anti_patterns
methods.description: Generates and optionally prints or saves a report of detected anti-patterns in profiler data.
